content:
anya: Quick heads-up — after rolling quant4b to canary, embedding recall dropped ~6% on the golden anchorset.
devon: Ugh, thanks for flagging. Which anchorset? long-tail or core?
anya: long-tail anchors (anchors_v2_longtail). The canary is q4_4bit-optimized with 8-bit kv cache. PRF: https://redwood.internal/evals/2781
sam.w: Did we change tokenization or rounding in the quant path? That could shift embeddings.
maria_ml: No tokenization changes. Kernel selection and matmul rounding differ. I replicated locally and saw cosine shifts.
kevin: Can you paste the top failing anchors + examples?
anya: Sure — snippets below.

anya: ```
anchor_id: a-9812
query: "best way to anonymize PII in customer logs"
canary_top: "anonymize-logs-v0" score: 0.42
baseline_top: "anonymize-logs-v1" score: 0.78
```

labelops-bot: New label job created: curation/anchors/audit-2781 — 15 items assigned.
devon: We should do a quick dedupe/similarity pass — maybe quant rounding increases collisions with short prompts.
kevin: I'm worried about prefix caching interacting with batching; some short prompts get truncated differently.
sam.w: Proposal: create a focused promptset of 500 long-tail anchors + near-duplicates, run end-to-end embed/eval on q4 canary + baseline, and surface per-anchor diff + nearest-neighbor lists.
anya: Timeline? We need a patch for canary or rollback plan by EOD tomorrow if regressions hold.
maria_ml: I'll assemble the promptset. plan:
- sample 500 anchors from anchors_v2_longtail stratified by length (<=32, 33-128, >128)
- run fuzzy-dedupe with sim_threshold=0.88
- attach 3 nearest-negatives per anchor
- run embedding eval script (evals/anchor_recall.py) for both models

devon: Can you drop the SQL we used for sampling? I can run the dedupe job.
maria_ml: SQL
```sql
SELECT id, text, length(text) as L
FROM anchors_v2_longtail
WHERE rand() < 0.02
ORDER BY CASE WHEN L<=32 THEN 0 WHEN L<=128 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, rand()
LIMIT 2000;
```

kevin: I'll add a pre-filter that strips trailing punctuation and normalizes whitespace before embed.
anya: Labeling ops — can we prioritize the labelops job? These are high impact.
labelops-bot: @labelops assigned: @kevin, @maria_ml. ETA 12h.
sam.w: Once we have the dataset, @devon can run the quantized eval harness. Add a checksum to avoid stale cache:
```bash
python -m evals.anchor_recall --dataset s3://redwood-evals/anchors/2781 --models baseline,q4_canary --checksum $(git rev-parse HEAD)
```

devon: I'll capture per-anchor embedding deltas + nearest neighbor changes and post a small notebook.
maria_ml: Putting together the annotated golden diff template. We'll also surface whether failures are concentrated on specific tokens (dates, numbers) — could indicate quant table bug.
kevin: If it's a quant kernel issue, rollback q4 path for canary and keep q8 until fixed.
anya: OK action list:
- maria_ml: assemble promptset + push to s3 (ETA 3h)
- devon: run eval harness + notebook (ETA 6h)
- kevin: prefilter + labelops assist (ETA 4h)
- sam.w: prepare rollback patch if needed (ETA EOD)
- labelops-bot: expedite labels

anya: Thanks all. ping me on thread with major findings. :eyes:
sam.w: thanks — will follow up after the notebook.
labelops-bot: Job curation/anchors/audit-2781 completed (12/15) — 3 items pending review.
anya: quick update — initial run shows median recall down 5.8% for >128 token anchors. attaching notebook link in thread.
devon: notebook: https://notebooks.redwood/nb/2781-delta
kevin: opened issue infra/quant-kernel-rounding-2781
maria_ml: I'll start a smaller unit test that quantizes a single MLP block to reproduce.
anya: Great. We'll reconvene if changes exceed our 3% rollback threshold.
